page.layout: Title page, one block, centred. Top: large spaced capitals "INTRODUCTIO", then "Ad lectionem Linguarum" and "ORIENTALIUM." Below: two columns of language names separated by a brace (left HEBRAICÆ to ARABICÆ, right PERSICÆ to COPTÆ). Then the printed text lines down to the imprint at the foot. No margin text, no engraving.

main_text.l: Confilium de earum Studio fœliciter instituendo[?], & de libris quos in hunc finem sibi comparare debent studiosi.

l.i: In usum tyronum qui linguas istas addiscere desiderant, præcipue eorum qui sumptus ad Biblia Polyglotta (jam[?] sub prælo) imprimenda contulerunt.

main_text.l: Præmittitur Præfatio, in qua de hisce linguis, & d[?]
Textuum, & versionum, quæ in dictis Bibliis habentur,
quidq; in hac Editione præ reliquis expectandum sit.
Imprimebat Tho. Roycroft, Et venales habentur
apud Timoth. Garthwait ad oftium minus Boreale

page.notes: The right edge of the page is cut off, so the end of the line "& d" and some letters at the line ends in the lines beginning "Præmittitur" and "Textuum" are uncertain. The brace between the two language columns is not printed text and is not transcribed. The word "instituendo" and "jam" in the parenthesis are partly covered by the printed brace and by show-through, so they are marked [?]. The lines "Ad lectionem Linguarum" and the first lines of the language list are set in different sizes and spacing; line breaks follow the scan.
